note: Readings made by looking at a page image, as the second extraction method next to the OCR/typed text. The reader is the Claude language model viewing cropped and 5x-upscaled copies of the image (Pillow, Lanczos); it is NOT a human reading and not a scholarly transcription. 'clear' = every character is formed; 'degraded' = at least one character is damaged and written '?'. A degraded cell is only compatible with a value, it is not confirmation of it. Images live in the git-ignored cache tmp/env-cache/ and are not committed.

image.quality: low resolution (291 px wide); digits in several cells are partly broken. ECW captions it as the Star and Sentinel, Gettysburg, August 11, 1885 (unverified).

readings.independence_note: Emerging Civil War's typed numbers (witness ecw) were most probably typed from this same image, so ecw and ecw-image are not independent of each other; both are independent of the Civil War Rx typed text (witness rx).
